dct_title_s: Greenland--west coast, (Denmark), Nordre Strømfjord to Egedesminde (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the National Imagery and Mapping Agency. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by spot heights. "From Danish charts to 1979." Georeferenced nautical chart. Map no. 38480.
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
